summary.text: Anthony Muse is a Democratic Maryland state senator from District 26 who is seeking re-election in the November 3, 2026 general election.
A pastor who founded the Ark of Safety Christian Church in Upper Marlboro, he previously served in the state Senate from 2007 to 2019 and returned to the seat in January 2023.

paragraphs.text: Anthony Muse was born in Baltimore on April 17, 1958.

He earned a B.A. in history from Morgan State University in 1981, a Master of Divinity from Wesley Theological Seminary in 1984, and a Doctor of Ministry in church and community development from Howard University in 1991.
Muse is the founder and senior pastor of Ark of Safety Christian Church in Upper Marlboro and was previously a pastor at United Methodist churches in Brandywine, Ellicott City and Catonsville.
Muse served in the Maryland House of Delegates from 1995 to 1998 and in the Maryland State Senate from 2007 to 2019.
Ballotpedia's campaign finance records also list a 2012 campaign for the U.S. Senate in Maryland, which he lost.
He assumed office in the state Senate again on January 11, 2023.
According to the General Assembly website, Muse is vice chair of the Executive Nominations Committee and a member of the Judicial Proceedings Committee.
